setup.api_key.tutorial_claude:
How to get your key:
1. Go to console.anthropic.com
2. Sign in or create an account
3. Go to Settings → API Keys
4. Click "Create Key" and copy it

The key starts with sk-ant-...
setup.api_key.tutorial_chatgpt:
How to get your key:
1. Go to platform.openai.com
2. Sign in or create an account
3. Go to API Keys in the sidebar
4. Click "Create new secret key" and copy it

The key starts with sk-...

cmd.effort.usage:
Usage: /effort <low|medium|high|auto>
- low: fast mode (smaller model, shorter output)
- medium: balanced (default)
- high: thorough mode (extended thinking)
- auto: let the system decide based on message complexity
cmd.mode.current:
Current quality mode: {current}
Usage: /mode <saver|balanced|thorough>
- saver: cheapest model, heuristic escalation
- balanced: auto-detected effort, reliable escalation only
- thorough: best model always, extended thinking
cmd.mode.usage:
Usage: /mode <saver|balanced|thorough>
- saver: cheapest model, heuristic escalation (saves money)
- balanced: auto-detected effort, reliable escalation only (default)
- thorough: best model always, extended thinking (best quality)

cmd.wake.status:
Wake word: "{current}" ({source}) — {status}, threshold: {threshold}

Usage:
  /wake              Show current wake word and status
  /wake list         List all pre-trained wake word models
  /wake <model>      Switch to a different wake word model
  /wake threshold <N> Set confidence threshold (0.0-1.0)
  /wake train <phrase> Train a custom wake word model
  /wake on|off       Enable/disable wake word detection
